row: HARTT (Humane Animal Rescue and Trapping Team) is an all-volunteer Arizona nonprofit organization that humanely captures lost pets, homeless dogs, and homeless cats who are severely injured (in other words, we don't do feral cat trapping).  We rescue animals who tend to run away from people and who cannot be easily leashed or picked up, using specialized training and humane capture equipment.  We also support owners with lost pet searches and lost pet consulting.  We are supported solely by donations.
